Sandbox_MaxTimeInServer_CapMinutes_toolt: How many real minutes each account may spend connected in one week. 600 is ten hours.
Sandbox_MaxTimeInServer_ResetDay_tooltip: Every account's minutes go back to zero at 00:00 on this day, in the night between the day before and it. Change this setting and everyone is back to zero within a minute, without waiting for that day to come round.
Sandbox_MaxTimeInServer_ExemptRoles_tool: Role names separated by semicolons. These accounts are never counted and never turned away, so you can always get in yourself. Empty means nobody is exempt, operators included.
Sandbox_MaxTimeInServer_BlockedMessage: What a refused player is told
Sandbox_MaxTimeInServer_BlockedMessage_t: Leave this empty and the mod says it in each player's own language. Write something and every player reads exactly that instead. It cannot contain a comma. Either way the numbers follow underneath.
Sandbox_MaxTimeInServer_GraceSeconds_too: How long a refused player gets to read why before their game disconnects itself.
